narrative.summaryIntro:
The Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple at Tirumala, in the Tirupati district of Andhra Pradesh, is dedicated to Venkateswara, a form of Vishnu. Set on the seventh peak of the Tirumala Hills, it is among the most visited religious sites in the world, receiving tens of thousands of pilgrims daily.

Administered by the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams, the temple is renowned for its ancient Dravidian shrine, the Ananda Nilayam golden vimana, the laddu prasadam, and centuries of documented endowments from the Pallava, Chola and Vijayanagara periods.
